changelog.title: Abin da ya canza, bisa tsari.
changelog.lede: Kowane canjin da aka gani da muka yi a wannan gidan yanar gizon kamfani, da kwanan wata da kuma haɗe da commit ɗin da ke baya. Kowane samfuri a tsarin Clap yana riƙe da nasa changelog a kan nasa yanki — wannan shafin ƙofar gida ce ta babban kamfani, babu fiye da haka, babu abin da aka ɓoye.
changelog.firstVersionBody: Babu wani lakabin da aka yi har yanzu. Kuna karanta gini {sha}. Shigarwar fitarwa ta farko za ta bayyana a nan da zarar an yi wa v1.0 lakabi.
changelog.metaDescription: Kowane canji da ake gani da muka yi, tare da kwanan watan da commit ɗin da ke bayansa.

roadmap.schemaDescription: Tsarin aiki na jama'a wanda ke nuna ayyukan da ake yi, waɗanda aka tsara, waɗanda aka kaddamar, da waɗanda aka dakatar.
roadmap.title: Abin da muke ginawa.
roadmap.lede: A fili. Babu vaporware. Kowane abu na ɓangaren studio ne — aikin gidan yanar gizo na kamfani, abubuwan da ake raba, da alkawura masu yaduwa da suka shafi kowane samfuri. Kowane samfuri a tsarin Clap yana riƙe da nasa tsarin aiki a kan nasa yanki. Abubuwan da ke nan suna haɗawa da code lokacin da aka tura su.
roadmap.emptyColumn: Babu komai a wannan rukuni a yanzu. Sabon aiki yana bayyana a nan yayin da yake ƙaura matakai.
roadmap.ctaHeading: Gaya mana abin da kake bukata.
roadmap.ctaBody: Idan akwai fasali, kayan aiki, ko gyara da zai yi bambanci na gaske a gare ka, aiko mana sako. Mukan karanta kowane sako kuma mukan ba da fifiko bisa la'akari da bukata ta gaske.
roadmap.metaDescription: Abin da muke ginawa, abin da aka tsara, abin da aka fitar da abin da aka dakatar — a sarari.

insights.schemaDescription: Tunani a fili: samun dama, daidaitawa, da dogon tafarki na AI.
insights.title: Tunani a fili.
insights.lede: Bayanai daga fili kan damar duniya gaba ɗaya, injiniyancin da AI ke taimakawa, mutum biliyan 2.2 da ke waje da yanar gizo, da kuma dogon tafiyar basirar wucin gadi — an rubuta su don a fahimce su, ba don a burge ba. Muna rubuta a hankali. Kowace iƙirari tana da maɓuɓɓuga. Babu clickbait, babu hayaƙin shugabancin tunani.
insights.emptyTitle: Babu abin da aka buga tukuna.
insights.emptyBody: Rubutu na farko zai bayyana a nan da zarar an shirya shi. Muna rubutu a hankali da kuma kulawa.
insights.metaDescription: Yin tunani a fili: shiga, daidaitawa, da dogon tafiya na AI.

trust.schemaDescription: Ginshiƙan amincinmu, masu sarrafa na uku, takaddun shaida, da yadda ake bayar da rahoton wani lamarin tsaro.
trust.title: Inda za ka samu hujja.
trust.lede: Kowane iƙirari da muke yi game da tsaro, sirri, dorewa, da damar shiga yana haɗawa da hujja. Ba za ka taɓa zama dole ka yarda da kalmarmu kawai ba.
trust.certsEmpty: Babu tukuna. Sa'ad da aka tabbatar da mu, za ta nuna a nan da haɗin gwiwa zuwa ga hujjar.
trust.certsEmptyBody: Mu ƙaramin studio ne. Takardun shaida na hukuma masu tsada ne kuma masu jinkiri. Sa'ad da muka samu ɗaya, za ta bayyana a nan da haɗin gwiwa zuwa ga mai bayarwa.
trust.subprocessorsLede: Kowane ɓangare na uku wanda zai iya taɓo bayananka, abin da yake samu, da kuma inda yake aiki.
trust.incidentHeading: Kun gano wani abu? Da fatan ku gaya mana tukuna.
trust.incidentBody: Bayyanawa cikin haɗin gwiwa shi ne hanyar da muke ɗauka da muhimmanci. Aiko email zuwa security@intelligentsingularityinc.com tare da bayanin da matakan sake gwadawa. Muna karɓar rahotanni a cikin ranar aiki ɗaya, muna tantance su cikin uku, kuma muna aikawa da gyara a cikin lokacin da muka yarda da ku. Ana ba masu bincike yabo da sunansu a cikin tsananin bayanmu lokacin da gyara ya tashi — sai dai idan kun fi son zama anonymous. Ba mu yi barazana ko shigar da kara wa masu binciken tsaro masu kyakkyawar niyya ba, ƙarshen labarin.
trust.metaDescription: Ginshiƙan amincewa, masu sarrafa na ɓangare na uku, takaddun shaida, da yadda za a ba da rahoton wani lamari.

help.schemaDescription: Cibiyar taimako — bincika kategori, shahararrun amsoshi, da tuntuɓa kai tsaye.
help.title: Yawanci muna iya taimaka da dannawa ɗaya kawai.
help.lede: Zaɓi layin da ya fi kama da tambayarka. Kowane mahaɗi yana zuwa wuri na gaske — babu fom ɗin da aka rufe, babu chatbots.
help.metaDescription: Sami taimako da sauri: bincika rukunoni, karanta amsoshi shahararru, ko tuntubi mutum a danna ɗaya.

about.schemaDescription: Sadu da tawaga da manufa a bayan Intelligent Singularity: gina software don samun damar duniya tare da ayyukan ƙwararru waɗanda AI ke ɗaukaka.
about.metaDescription: Hadu da tawagar da manufa a bayan Intelligent Singularity: ƙirƙirar software don samun damar duniya tare da ayyuka masu sauƙi waɗanda AI ta haɓaka.

manifesto.offlinePercentHeading: Mutum biliyan biyu da kashi biyu cikin goma har yanzu suna waje da yanar gizo a yau.
manifesto.offlinePercentBody: Ɗigogi masu haske a sama mutane ne waɗanda ke kan layi. Ɗigogi masu duhu, masu zobe mutane ne waɗanda ba sa kan layi. Kashi 96 cikin ɗari na waɗanda ba sa kan layi suna zaune ne a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗin shiga da matsakaicin kuɗin shiga. Injiniyancin damar duniya gaba ɗaya shi ne abin da ke rufe wannan giɓin. Alkawura tara da ke ƙasa su ne yadda muke riƙe da kanmu.
manifesto.commitmentsBody: Zoba tara masu tsakiya guda — kowane samfuri yana shiga ne bisa kowane ɗayansu, a kowane lokaci. Jerin ba jerin abubuwan da ake so ba ne. Kwangilar injiniyanci ce.
manifesto.schemaDescription: Karanta sanarwarmu game da mai da software na manyan kamfanoni a matsayin hakki na asali ga kowane kasuwanci da mutum, ta yanar gizo ko ba tare da intanet ba.
manifesto.globeSvgTitle: Isarwa ba tare da intanet ba
manifesto.globeAriaLabel: Sauƙin duniya tare da haskaka maki biliyan 2.2 da ba a kan layi ba, suna nuna ƙididdigar ITU akan rabuwar dijital.
manifesto.ringsAriaLabelTemplate: Alkawura {count} masu wuri ɗaya da suka samar da zobe ɗaya na samun isa ga kowa — ƙa'idodin injiniya da kowace samfur ke fitarwa a kowane fitarwa.
manifesto.metaDescription: Karanta sanarwarmu game da maida software na ma'aikatu zama hakki na kowane kasuwanci da kowane mutum, a kan layi ko ba a kan layi ba.

faq.schemaDescription: Amsoshi na gaskiya game da studio, samfuranmu, ayyukan sirri, da yadda za a haɗa hannu da Intelligent Singularity.

pricing.schemaDescription: Ka'idodin farashinmu: matakin kyauta, farashi mai adalci bisa yanki, kowane fasali a kowane mataki, babu tuntubar tallace-tallace.
pricing.sixRulesHeading: Six rules every product ships under
pricing.antiPatternsBody: The anti-patterns below are common in business software. We have decided against each of them, in writing, in advance — so neither we nor a future us can quietly bring them back.
pricing.workedExampleBody: A worked example — illustrative, not a price quote — to show how the six rules play out in practice. Specific numbers live on each product’s own page.
pricing.metaDescription: Yadda muke ƙayyade farashin kowane samfur: matakin kyauta har abada, farashi da aka daidaita da ikon siyan kuɗi, kowane fasali a kowane mataki, farashin da aka buga, babu sayar da tuntuɓa.

careers.schemaDescription: Yadda ɗakin yake ɗaukar ma'aikata da kuma yadda ake aiki a Intelligent Singularity.
careers.whatYouWouldWorkOnHeading: Abin da za ka yi aiki a kai da gaske
careers.howWeHireHeading: Yadda muke ɗaukar ma'aikata, daga farko zuwa ƙarshe
careers.whatYouWouldWorkOnLede: Intelligent Singularity ita ce kamfanin uba ga dangi mai girma na dandamali. Sabbin ma'aikata ba sa yawan aiki kan samfuri ɗaya na cikakken shekara — galibi suna juyawa tsakanin biyu ko uku, ya danganta da abin da ake aikawa da kuma abin da ke buƙatar fiye da kulawar manyan ma'aikata a wancan kwata.
careers.howWeHireLede: Matakai huɗu. Mafi yawa makonni biyu daga imel na farko zuwa tayin da aka rubuta idan ɓangarorin biyu suka yi sauri. Babu matakai masu ban mamaki, babu ayyukan gida marasa biyan kuɗi, babu ƙin yarda na "dacewa da al'ada" ba tare da dalilai a rubuce ba.
careers.metaDescription: Yadda studiyo ke ɗaukar ma'aikata: ƙaramin ƙungiya, mai nesa, da AI ta haɓaka wadda ke fitar da software na samun damar duniya. Bukatun ma'aikata na yanzu da gayyatar dindindin don gabatar da kanka.

press.storyAnglesDeclineHeading: Kusurwoyin labari da galibi muke ƙi
press.boilerplateLede: Sakin layi ɗaya, mai shirye-shiryen shigarwa cikin sakon manema labarai. An amince da amfani kalma-kalma.
press.storyAnglesYesLede: Idan labarinka ya zauna a cikin ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan kusurwoyi, za mu yi sauri don sa wanda ya kafa, injiniya, ko shugaban samfuri ya kasance — yawanci a cikin rana ɗaya ta aiki.
press.storyAnglesNoLede: Gaskiya tun farko tana ceton kowa lokaci. Ba za mu ba da maganganu don kusurwoyin da ke ƙasa ba. Duk da haka, za mu nuna maka ɗan jarida ko mai bincike wanda aikinsa ya fi dacewa da labarin.
press.schemaName: Manema labarai & Kafofin watsa labarai | Intelligent Singularity
press.schemaDescription: Kayan aikin manema labarai, takardar gaskiya, kalmomi da aka amince da su, da hanyar tuntuɓar manema labarai da masu bincike masu rufe Intelligent Singularity.

portfolio.lede: Intelligent Singularity ita ce mahaifiyar kamfanin tsarin Clap. Kowane samfuri yana aiki ne a kan nasa yanki, a ƙarƙashin nasa sharuɗɗa, da nasa farashi — amma suna raba tarin injiniyanci ɗaya, kasafin samun damar shiga ɗaya, matsayin sirri ɗaya, da kuma yadudduka na AI-agent na haɗin gwiwa ɗaya. Alamar matsayi mai gaskiya a ko'ina: production, staging, jiran amincewa, kayayyakin asali.

contact.responseTimeBody: Mutum yana karanta kowane saƙo. Muna amsa cikin kwanaki biyu na aiki a lokutan aikin UTC−07:00 (Mountain). Ana ba fifiko ga binciken tsaro da na shari'a — ana tabbatar da rahotannin tsaro cikin ranar aiki ɗaya. Za mu iya amsawa cikin kowane harshe goma sha huɗu da wannan rukunin yanar gizo ke magana.

security.dataHeading: Yadda muke kula da bayanan ka
security.complianceHeading: Ka'idodin da muke riƙe wa kanmu
security.complianceLede: Muna bin ƙananan, sunaye masu suna na ƙa'idodi — kuma muna gaskiya game da binciken da ba mu samu ba tukuna.
security.schemaDescription: Hanyoyin tsaro da gudanar da bayanai a duk faɗin Intelligent Singularity: encryption, masaukin kanmu, sifili kira na ɓangare na uku, da gajeren ajiyar bayanai.
security.shieldAriaLabel: Garkuwa mai sauƙi da ke nuna matsayin tsaro: rufa TLS, sifili kira na ɓangare na uku, yanayin samfura masu keɓe, gajeren ajiyar bayanai, da wakilan sake sarrafa bayanai da aka ambata.
security.metaDescription: Yadda muke kare wannan rukunin yanar gizo da kowane samfur a portfolio: TLS, sifili na kira na ɓangare na uku, riƙe gajere, ajiya da aka ɓoye, da amsa mai gaskiya ga abubuwan da suka faru.

green.schemaDescription: Duba alkawuranmu na muhalli, gaskiya kan nauyin shafi, da hanyarmu ta aikin yanar gizo mai ƙarancin hayaƙi.
green.statHostingHint: VPS guda · grid na Alberta (~{percent}% mai sabuntawa)
green.statThirdPartyHint: Babu pixels · babu fonts · babu CDN
green.byteBudgetHeading: Yadda kasafin byte ke zama ƙanƙanta
green.pledgeHeading: Mun buga komai. Kuna riƙe mu da alhakin.
green.pledgeBody: Kowane lamba a wannan shafin ana ƙididdiga shi kai-tsaye daga ainihin ma'auni. Kasafin tarin ana tilasta shi ta CI; an duba ƙidayar ɓangare na uku a kowane gini; ƙididdigar carbon tana amfani da hanyar Green Web Foundation akan nauyin shafin da kuka loda. Idan wani abu ya yi kama da kuskure, gaya mana — za mu amsa a rubuce a cikin kwanaki biyar na aiki, tare da nuna lambobi na asali.

bundleBudget.label: Kasafin tari
bundleBudget.hint: Gzipped. An tilasta shi ta CI a kowane pull request — gini da ya karya kasafin ba zai iya tashi ba.

thirdPartyCalls.label: Kira na ɓangare na uku
thirdPartyCalls.hint: Babu analytics, fonts, pixels, video embeds, social widgets, ko CDN round-trips. Ana duba kowane gini ta no-third-party.mjs.

renderer.label: Mai bayarwa
renderer.hint: Shafuka suna bayar da kayan a kan server kuma ana yaɗa su zuwa browser. Hydration na opt-in, kowane component, ba duniya ba.

mediaStrategy.label: Dabarar media
mediaStrategy.hint: Babu masu jarumai na raster. Hotunan SVG na cikin layi. Ƙananan fonts na kowane script suna lodawa kawai lokacin da wannan script yake a shafin.

hosting.label: Hosting
hosting.hint: Mai-gida a kan VPS guda a Edmonton, Alberta. Babu CDN. Babu edge nodes. Asali ɗaya, iyaka amincewa ɗaya.

offlineReach.label: Cimma na offline
offlineReach.hint: HTML mai-network-tsaye · kayan stale-while-revalidate · shafin offline fallback a kowane harshe.

reducedMotion.label: Rage motsi
reducedMotion.hint: Kowane animation yana tsayawa lokacin da prefers-reduced-motion aka saita. Babu keɓancewa, babu buƙatar opt-out.

paperless.label: Ba takarda ta tsohuwa
paperless.hint: Daftari, bayanan likita, rasit suna zuwa dijital ta tsohuwa. Takardar ofis, kati na kasuwanci, da kayan tallace-tallace na bugawa ba sa cikin yadda muke aiki.

green.metaDescription: Duba alkawuran muhalli, nuna gaskiya na nauyin shafuka, da kuma hanyar mu ta yin aikin yanar gizo da ƙananan iskar gas.
